name: Faff
notes: Faff is a human-plus-AI personal assistant for non-work life admin across 30+ categories, including groceries, repairs, bookings, appointments, travel, gifting and refund chasing. It runs entirely inside WhatsApp and is available across India. Requested via the form (issue #309).

access.price: From ₹1,999/month; discounted quarterly and smaller plans, unlimited tasks
